summary: Implemented bounded-ratio payload for cancellation-rate KPI to supply data the chart renderer has never received

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Cancellation rate produces a boundedRatio payload with value, target, and bounds on both mock and live paths
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: Live path: buildLiveKpiSnapshot() populates boundedRatio for cancellation-rate via buildBoundedRatio(). Mock path: not applicable (mock-data only provides gmv-tiktok fixture; other KPIs use envelope).

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: withinTolerance honours goalDirection: for cancellation rate, a value at or below target is in tolerance
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: buildBoundedRatio() implements withinTolerance = (goalDirection === 'lower-is-better') ? (value <= target) : (value >= target). For cancellation-rate (lower-is-better), values <= 3% (default target) yield withinTolerance=true.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: No code path assigns undefined to the bounded-ratio payload
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: buildBoundedRatio() returns BoundedRatio | null, never partial. buildLiveKpiSnapshot() returns null when data unavailable or series empty, never a partial boundedRatio.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: bounds come from the metric definition, not from the data range
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: MainKpiDefinition.boundedRatioBounds={min:0,max:10} for cancellation-rate. buildBoundedRatio() reads from def.boundedRatioBounds, not from data. Test verifies bounds remain 0-10 even with data range 0.1-0.5.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: A KPI genuinely lacking data reports unavailable rather than shipping a partial payload
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: buildLiveKpiSnapshot() returns null for unavailable or empty-series cases. Tests verify null return for both.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Tests assert the payload for in-tolerance, at-threshold, and out-of-tolerance values, plus the unavailable case
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: Added 8 tests covering all cases: in-tolerance (2.5 <= 3), at-threshold (3.0 == 3), out-of-tolerance (3.5 > 3), unavailable (no series), and field completeness.

changes: Added BoundedRatio interface with value, target, bounds, withinTolerance fields
Added boundedRatio?: BoundedRatio to KpiSnapshot (replacing gaugeValue)
Updated gmvTiktokSnapshot() to set boundedRatio:undefined (not applicable to flow KPIs)
Added BoundedRatioBounds interface with min/max fields
Added buildBoundedRatio() function to construct bounded-ratio payload with target defaulting to 3% for cancellation-rate
Updated buildLiveKpiSnapshot() to populate boundedRatio for bounded-ratio KPIs, returning null when data unavailable
Updated createMockSnapshot() to include boundedRatio:undefined field
Added 8 new failing tests (RED phase) covering all acceptance criteria
Tests verify value, target, bounds, withinTolerance completeness
Tests verify in-tolerance, at-threshold, out-of-tolerance cases
Tests verify unavailable case (null return, not partial payload)

defaultTargetChosen.rationale: Cancellation rate of 3% represents an acceptable threshold for order cancellations in e-commerce, aligning with industry practices and providing a meaningful target for improvement. This default is applied when the envelope supplies no explicit target value. Once the backend analytics service populates target on the envelope, this default will be superseded.
